gloss: to process; to manufacture; to work (raw materials)

definitions.gloss: to process; to manufacture; to work (raw materials)
definitions.explanation: to process; to manufacture; to work (raw materials)

definitions.gloss: to edit; to alter; to manipulate (images, data)
definitions.explanation: to edit; to alter; to manipulate (images, data)

examples.japanese: {木材|もくざい}を{加工|かこう}する。
この{工場|こうじょう}では{金属|きんぞく}を{加工|かこう}している。
{原料|げんりょう}を{加工|かこう}して{製品|せいひん}にするまでに{数|すう}か{月|げつ}かかる。
examples.english: It takes several months to process raw materials into finished products.

examples.japanese: {写真|しゃしん}を{加工|かこう}する。
アプリで{画像|がぞう}を{加工|かこう}してSNSに{投稿|とうこう}した。
examples.english: I edited the image with an app and posted it on social media.

examples.japanese: データを{加工|かこう}して{見|み}やすいグラフにまとめた。
examples.english: I processed the data and organized it into an easy-to-read graph.

notes:
Refers to transforming raw materials into a finished or usable form through manufacturing or processing. In modern usage, it is widely used for editing or manipulating digital content such as photos and data.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食品|しょくひん}{加工|かこう}: food processing
- {加工|かこう}{食品|しょくひん}: processed food
- {画像|がぞう}{加工|かこう}: image editing
- {金属|きんぞく}{加工|かこう}: metalworking
- {加工|かこう}{技術|ぎじゅつ}: processing technology

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {製造|せいぞう}する: to manufacture — focuses on creating finished products, especially in industrial settings
- {編集|へんしゅう}する: to edit — used for editing text, video, or audio content, while {加工|かこう} is more common for image manipulation
- {処理|しょり}する: to process; to handle — broader term covering any kind of handling or dealing with something, not limited to physical transformation
